events.title: 리버풀 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 draw 1–1 at Anfield to keep the gap at the top three points wide. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 miss the chance to cut the gap between themselves and the top two after being held to a 2–2 draw at 노츠 카운티. 노팅엄 포리스트 close in on the top three with a 3–2 away win over 루턴 타운. 토트넘 홋스퍼's erratic league form continues with a 3–2 home defeat to 왓퍼드. 셰필드 웬즈데이 regain their lead of the Second Division with a 3–0 home win over 올덤 애슬레틱. 맨체스터 시티 are held to a 1–1 draw at home to 리즈 유나이티드 and surrender their top-three place to 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, who beat 반즐리 1–0 at home.
The FA Cup third round ties begin with a 4–0 win for 리버풀 at home to 뉴캐슬 유나이티드.

본머스 pull off one of the biggest FA Cup upsets of all time with a 2–0 win over holders 맨체스터 유나이티드 in the third round. 아스널, 레스터 시티 and QPR lose to Second Division opponents (미들즈브러, 크리스털 팰리스 and 허더즈필드 타운 respectively), while 맨체스터 시티 are beaten 2–1 by Fourth Division 블랙풀 . Telford make it three giant-killing ties in a row by beating 로치데일 4–1 at Spotland .

레스터 시티 continue their climb towards safety with a 5–2 away win over local rivals 노츠 카운티. Leaders 리버풀 suffer a shock 1–0 home defeat at home to 울버햄프턴 원더러스, with Steve Mardenborough scoring the only goal of the game and giving 울버햄프턴 원더러스 a major boost in their bid for survival, making it three wins from their last four league games.
QPR beat 스토크 시티 6–0 at Loftus Road to put themselves fourth in the First Division and six points behind leaders 리버풀.

Ian Rush scores a hat-trick in 리버풀's 3–1 away win over 애스턴 빌라 in the First Division, increasing their lead at the top to five points, although their nearest challengers 맨체스터 유나이티드 can cut the gap to two points if they win at the weekend.

맨체스터 유나이티드 cut 리버풀's lead of the First Division to two points by beating 사우샘프턴 3–2 at Old Trafford . 웨스트햄 유나이티드 keep up their title challenge with a 2–0 home win over 웨스트브로미치 앨비언, as do 노팅엄 포리스트 with a 3–0 home win over 노리치 시티.
노팅엄 포리스트 are now just three points off the top of the First Division after beating 사우샘프턴 1–0 at The Dell .
에버턴 reach the League Cup semi-finals with a 4–1 win over 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 in their quarter-final replay clash at Goodison Park.
리버풀 reach the League Cup semi-finals with a 3–0 win over 셰필드 웬즈데이 in their quarter-final replay clash at Anfield .
스토크 시티 boost their survival hopes by beating 아스널 1–0 in their First Division clash at the Victoria Ground .
Brighton & Hove Albion knock 리버풀 out of the FA Cup for the second season running.
본머스 's FA Cup run ends with in a 2–0 defeat to 미들즈브러 in the fourth round at Ayresome Park . 에버턴 are held to a goalless draw by 질링엄 in their fourth round tie at Priestfield .
